description: This file defines the UndoRejectClientCommandHandler class which handles the undo rejection command for client entities in the Fineract system. It implements the command to revert a client's rejection status and calls the relevant service method to perform this action.

classes.name: UndoRejectClientCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles 'UNDOREJECT' commands for clients, providing a method to process the command and revert a client's rejection status.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo rejection command by invoking the service method to perform the undo operation.
